title: Arrange Shapes in Pattern (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Arrange Shapes in Pattern applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Arrange Shapes in Pattern (BtnArrangeInShape) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnArrangeInShape places the selection on the documented pattern outline

requirements.text: BtnArrangeInShape arranges selected shapes on the chosen geometric pattern outline; the pattern math is deterministic and host-free-testable.

done.statement: The deterministic host-free scenario places the probe centers on the documented triangle outline and passes; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews (office-only gate) remains until QA9-BtnArrangeInShape-002 has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.expected: On the same fixed four-shape fixture, the triangle outline pattern places the shape centers at (200,-12.5), (303.92,167.5), (200,227.5), (96.08,167.5) - the documented perimeter walk - and the other pattern families (circle, square grid, filled triangle, star inner-vertex radius, reserved center) follow their documented formulas.

scenarios.title: BtnArrangeInShape deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: Real-host acceptance for the pattern-outline placement of selected shapes.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed BtnArrangeInShape arranges four fixed probes on the triangle outline so that every probe shape center matches the hard-coded documented perimeter positions within 1 pt, the feature reports execution, all probes remain, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
